about: A yearly rule's day in its months, one wording rule for the server (Series\Words) and the editor (web/src/lib/repeat.js): the months with the day, each with it, then the listed months without it as skipped. Read by server/tests/series-model.php and web/tests/smoke.mjs. `server` is the server's day-month order; `editor` is the editor's words read in month-day order.

rows.server: Yearly on 31 January and 31 May, skipping February and April
rows.editor: Yearly on Jan 31 and May 31, skipping February and April

rows.server: Yearly on 29 February and 29 March, February only in leap years
rows.editor: Yearly on Feb 29 and Mar 29, February only in leap years

rows.server: Yearly on 29 February, only in leap years
rows.editor: Yearly on 29 February, only in leap years
